annotations.title: Check which planets are retrograde, and until when

description:
Reports which planets are retrograde on a date and the two stations that open and close each body's current period ("since 2026-02-14, until 2026-03-07"). Per body: retrograde flag, ecliptic longitude, longitude speed, sign and degree, and both stations with exact UTC instants.

The dates shift every cycle and follow no fixed calendar rule; Mercury stations retrograde three or four times a year. A station is where longitude speed crosses zero, found by bisection for eight bodies, so this takes longer than a single-instant position.

Excluded: the Sun and Moon, which cannot station, and Rahu and Ketu, whose mean motion is backwards throughout. The "excluded" array lists them.

Results include an attribution line and a permalink.

date.description: The date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, 1700-2200. Example: "2026-03-01". Defaults to today (UTC).

time.description: Time of day HH:MM, read as UTC. Example: "12:00". Matters within a day of a station.
